title: Engineering science
blurb: The general engineering under every plant: forces, motion and materials, then heat, fluids and pumps, then reading the drawings of any system. Each course is built in full before you open it.

folders.title: Engineering science
folders.blurb: Mechanical and thermal principles from first principles, in the order a marine engineering course meets them.

courses.title: Mechanics and materials
courses.blurb: Forces, moments and stress; motion, energy and power; rotation, torque and the shafts and gears that carry it.

courses.title: Heat and fluids
courses.blurb: Temperature, heat and how it moves; gases and pressure; flow, pumps and the engines that turn heat into work.

courses.title: Reading drawings and schematics
courses.blurb: How to read any system diagram: electrical schematics, hydraulic and pneumatic circuits, piping diagrams and engineering drawings.
